reason: A configuration-based DeepSeek Harness bridge that integrates OpenAI-compatible vision models, sends image-bearing messages for visual analysis, and forwards the resulting description to DeepSeek for reasoning and final responses.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入可选的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，并将图像分析结果转交 DeepSeek 生成最终回答。
summaries.en: Connects selectable OpenAI-compatible vision models to DeepSeek Harness and forwards image analysis results to DeepSeek for reasoning and final responses.

capabilities: Routes image-bearing messages to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Uses configured provider credentials or environment variables for vision requests
Transforms vision analysis into text for DeepSeek to generate the final response
Discovers image-capable models from configured Harness providers
